1| # driftwatch export recovery
2| 
3| A failed export run resumes from the last completed shard on the next
4| trigger; a failed shard retries independently. Recovery after an
5| outage is therefore a catch-up problem, not a correctness one.
6| 
7| ## Catch-up runs
8| 
9| Catch-up runs walk the backlog oldest-first so warehouse dashboards
10| fill in chronological order. Size the uploader pool for the loader's
11| provisioning, not ours: the loader's memory scales with concurrent
12| shards, and a pool that outruns it turns catch-up into a second
13| incident.
14| 
15| ## Counting
16| 
17| Skipped runs are not failures. The failure panel splits them since the
18| outage review, and the month reads clean when only real failures
19| count.
